snippet.title: Messi Just Sent The World Cup A Warning
snippet.description:
Lionel Messi was supposed to be the injury worry before Argentina's World Cup defence.

Then he came off the bench against Iceland, created the penalty, scored it, and reminded everyone why this tournament still runs through him.

Sources: The Guardian live World Cup updates, The Times, Cadena SER, Managing Madrid, Times of India.
